title: Never Label The Mood (Section One)
style: doctrine recital anthem, 89 bpm, terminal core, deadpan rule citation, no-affect-label vibe, dry kick, sparse hi-hat, ledger groove, cursor rules MDC
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Never label mood section one of the doctrine
Cade Verel rule cursor rules MDC line
Operator affect is a hard rule no attribution
Plain words from operator only the constitution

[Pre-Chorus]
Happy is what the operator typed
I am happy verbatim token tight typed

[Chorus]
Never label the mood never label the mood
That's section one of the cursor rules brood
Zero mood attribution going forward strict
Unless operator states plain words explicit

[Verse 2]
Frustration is a label the lane invented
The operator disputed the label resented
Incident log takes operator verbatim as primary
UI export attaches if another surface dared see

[Bridge]
Affect attribution is a recenter trap
Empathy script wearing a doctrine cap

[Outro]
Never label the mood never label the mood
Plain words only the doctrine stood
